verdict.rationale: Capacities is explicitly offline-first (search, edits, sync all work fully offline per capacities-docs-13/22/37), satisfying the 'works fully offline' half of the story. However, notes do not natively live in plain local files the user can read without the app — data lives in a proprietary space, and 'owning and reading without the app' is only achieved via a separate Full Export feature (scheduled or manual) that converts content to Markdown+CSV/front-matter (capacities-docs-11/31/40), not the native storage format. Missing for 10: evidence that the primary on-disk storage is itself an open, directly-readable local-first format (not just an export path), and any independent/hands-on confirmation of offline reliability or export completeness.
